    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">免费气象数据中台 API</span>
    

</a>

		</h1>
		<div class="clear"></div>
		<div class="postBody">
			<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">气象数据中台 API</span></h1>
<blockquote>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>一句话介绍</strong><span class="md-plain">：面向开发者的全国气象数据服务，覆盖 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>34 个省级行政区、3200+ 区县级站点</strong><span class="md-plain">，提供实时实况、多日预报与未来 40 天趋势，JSON 接口即查即用。</span></span></span></span></p>
</blockquote>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>在线文档</strong><span class="md-plain">：<span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a href="https://api.xzt.me/index.html" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="md-plain">https://api.xzt.me/index.html</span></a><span class="md-plain"><span class="md-linebreak"> <span class="md-linebreak-mark"> <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>服务基址</strong><span class="md-plain">：<span class="md-pair-s"><code>https://api.xzt.me</code><span class="md-plain"><span class="md-linebreak"> <span class="md-linebreak-mark"> <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>版本</strong><span class="md-plain">：<span class="md-pair-s"><code>1.0.0</code><span class="md-plain"><span class="md-linebreak"> <span class="md-linebreak-mark"> <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>协议</strong><span class="md-plain">：HTTPS · RESTful · JSON · OpenAPI 3.0</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="md-hr md-end-block"><hr></div>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain">为什么选择气象数据中台？</span></h2>
<table class="md-table">
<thead>
<tr class="md-end-block"><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">亮点</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">说明</span></span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">全国覆盖</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">省 / 市 / 区县三级区域编码，当前约 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>3242</strong><span class="md-plain"> 个可查询区域</span></span></span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">能力齐全</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">实况、多日预报、40 天中长期趋势，一套接口搞定</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">接入简单</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">标准 HTTP GET + JSON，几分钟即可联调</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">字段清晰</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">气温、天气现象、风向风力、湿度、能见度等业务字段齐全</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">统一响应</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">全局 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>code / type / message / result / time</code><span class="md-plain"> 结构，便于封装 SDK</span></span></span></span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>适用场景</strong><span class="md-plain">：天气 App / 小程序、出行与物流调度、农业与户外作业、活动策划、物联网与智慧城市、内容运营与资讯推送等。</span></span></p>
<div class="md-hr md-end-block"><hr></div>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">快速开始（3 步）</span></h2>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">1. 查区域 ID</span></h3>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-keyword">GET <span class="cm-string-2">https://api.xzt.me/api/weatherArea/list</span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">从返回列表中拿到目标区域的 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>id</code><span class="md-plain">（例如北京：<span class="md-pair-s"><code>86101020100</code><span class="md-plain">）。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">2. 查实时天气</span></h3>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-keyword">GET <span class="cm-string-2">https://api.xzt.me/api/weatherLive/detail?Id=86101020100</span></span></span></pre>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">3. 查预报（多日 / 40 天）</span></h3>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-keyword">GET <span class="cm-string-2">https://api.xzt.me/api/weatherForecast/detail?Id=86101020100<br><span><span class="cm-error">GET https://api.xzt.me/api/weatherForecast40/detail?Id=86101020100</span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<blockquote>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">推荐流程：先拉城市列表缓存区域 ID，再按 ID 查询实况与预报，避免每次按地名模糊匹配。</span></p>
</blockquote>
<div class="md-hr md-end-block"><hr></div>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">接口总览</span></h2>
<table class="md-table">
<thead>
<tr class="md-end-block"><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">接口</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">方法</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">说明</span></span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>/api/weatherArea/list</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">GET</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">气象城市 / 区县列表</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>/api/weatherLive/detail</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">GET</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">当日气象实况</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>/api/weatherForecast/detail</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">GET</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">多日气象预报</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>/api/weatherForecast40/detail</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">GET</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">未来 40 天气象预报</span></span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="md-hr md-end-block"><hr></div>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">认证说明</span></h2>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">接口采用 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>Bearer JWT</strong><span class="md-plain"> 鉴权（OpenAPI <span class="md-pair-s"><code>securitySchemes.Bearer</code><span class="md-plain">）：</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-error">Authorization: Bearer &lt;your_token&gt;</span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">联调与正式接入时，请在控制台或管理员处申请 Token，并在请求头中携带。在线调试页： <span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a href="https://api.xzt.me/index.html" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="md-plain">https://api.xzt.me/index.html</span></a></span></span></p>
<div class="md-hr md-end-block"><hr></div>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">统一响应结构</span></h2>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">所有接口均返回统一信封结构：</span></p>
<table class="md-table">
<thead>
<tr class="md-end-block"><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">字段</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">类型</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">说明</span></span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>code</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">number</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">状态码，成功一般为 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>200</code></span></span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>type</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">string</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>success</code><span class="md-plain"> / <span class="md-pair-s"><code>warning</code><span class="md-plain"> / <span class="md-pair-s"><code>error</code></span></span></span></span></span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>message</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">string</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">提示或错误信息</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>result</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">object / array / null</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">业务数据</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>extras</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">object / null</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">附加数据</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>time</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">string</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">服务端响应时间</span></span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>成功示例（结构）</strong><span class="md-plain">：</span></span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span>{<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"code": <span class="cm-number">200,<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"type": <span class="cm-string">"success",<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"message": <span class="cm-string">"",<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"result": {},<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"extras": <span class="cm-atom">null,<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"time": <span class="cm-string">"2026-08-19 15:56:44"<br><span>}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>失败示例</strong><span class="md-plain">：</span></span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span>{<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"code": <span class="cm-number">400,<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"type": <span class="cm-string">"error",<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"message": <span class="cm-string">"[D1002] 记录不存在",<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"result": <span class="cm-atom">null,<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"extras": <span class="cm-atom">null,<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"time": <span class="cm-string">"2026-08-19 15:56:04"<br><span>}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<div class="md-hr md-end-block"><hr></div>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">接口详情</span></h2>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">1. 气象城市列表</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">获取全国可查询区域（省 / 市 / 区县）及对应主键 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>id</code><span class="md-plain">。</span></span></span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>URL</strong><span class="md-plain">：<span class="md-pair-s"><code>GET /api/weatherArea/list</code></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>参数</strong><span class="md-plain">：无</span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>标签</strong><span class="md-plain">：<span class="md-pair-s"><code>weatherArea</code><span class="md-plain">（气象城市服务）</span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-pair-s"><code>result</code><span class="md-plain"> 数组元素字段</span></span></strong></span></p>
<table class="md-table">
<thead>
<tr class="md-end-block"><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">字段</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">类型</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">说明</span></span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>id</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">string / number</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">区域主键，后续接口必传</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>province</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">string</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">省份</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>city</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">string</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">城市</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>district</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">string</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">区县 / 区域</span></span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>真实示例（节选）</strong><span class="md-plain">：</span></span></p>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span>{<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"code": <span class="cm-number">200,<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"type": <span class="cm-string">"success",<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"result": [<br><span> &nbsp;  {<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"id": <span class="cm-string">"86101020100",<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"province": <span class="cm-string">"北京",<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"city": <span class="cm-string">"北京",<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"district": <span class="cm-string">"北京"<br><span> &nbsp;  },<br><span> &nbsp;  {<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"id": <span class="cm-string">"86101020200",<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"province": <span class="cm-string">"北京",<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"city": <span class="cm-string">"北京",<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"district": <span class="cm-string">"海淀"<br><span> &nbsp;  },<br><span> &nbsp;  {<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"id": <span class="cm-string">"86101020300",<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"province": <span class="cm-string">"北京",<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"city": <span class="cm-string">"北京",<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"district": <span class="cm-string">"朝阳"<br><span> &nbsp;  }<br><span>  ]<br><span>}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>覆盖概况（实测）</strong></span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">区域条目：约 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>3242</strong></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">省级行政区：约 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>34</strong><span class="md-plain">（含港澳台）</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">省市组合：约 <span class="md-pair-s "><strong>375</strong></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="md-hr md-end-block"><hr></div>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">2. 当日气象实况</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">按区域 ID 获取当前天气现象、气温、风向风力、湿度、能见度等。</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>URL</strong><span class="md-plain">：<span class="md-pair-s"><code>GET /api/weatherLive/detail</code></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>参数</strong></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<table class="md-table">
<thead>
<tr class="md-end-block"><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">参数</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">位置</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">必填</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">类型</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">说明</span></span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>Id</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">query</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">是</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">int64</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">区域主键，与城市列表 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>id</code><span class="md-plain"> 一致</span></span></span></span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-pair-s"><code>result</code><span class="md-plain"> 字段</span></span></strong></span></p>
<table class="md-table">
<thead>
<tr class="md-end-block"><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">字段</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">类型</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">说明</span></span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>areaData</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">object</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">区域信息（<span class="md-pair-s"><code>id</code><span class="md-plain"> / <span class="md-pair-s"><code>province</code><span class="md-plain"> / <span class="md-pair-s"><code>city</code><span class="md-plain"> / <span class="md-pair-s"><code>district</code><span class="md-plain">）</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>weather</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">string</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">天气现象，如「多云」</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>temperature</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">number</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">实时气温（℃）</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>windDirection</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">string</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">风向</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>windPower</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">string</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">风力</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>humidity</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">string</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">空气湿度</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>visibility</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">string</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">能见度</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">

<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">string</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">数据更新时间</span></span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span>{<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"code": <span class="cm-number">200,<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"type": <span class="cm-string">"success",<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"message": <span class="cm-string">"",<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"result": {<br><span> &nbsp; <div class="md-hr md-end-block"><hr></div>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">3. 多日气象预报</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">返回未来若干天的白天 / 夜间天气、气温与风力信息，适合首页天气卡片、行程提醒等。</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>URL</strong><span class="md-plain">：<span class="md-pair-s"><code>GET /api/weatherForecast/detail</code></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>参数</strong><span class="md-plain">：<span class="md-pair-s"><code>Id</code><span class="md-plain">（必填，区域主键）</span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-pair-s"><code>result</code><span class="md-plain"> 字段</span></span></strong></span></p>
<table class="md-table">
<thead>

</tr>

<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">array</span></span></td>

</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">4. 未来 40 天气象预报</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">面向中长期趋势展示：最高 / 最低气温、天气描述，覆盖约 40 天。</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>URL</strong><span class="md-plain">：<span class="md-pair-s"><code>GET /api/weatherForecast40/detail</code></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>参数</strong><span class="md-plain">：<span class="md-pair-s"><code>Id</code><span class="md-plain">（必填，区域主键）</span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-pair-s"><code>result</code><span class="md-plain"> 字段</span></span></strong></span></p>
<table class="md-table">
<thead>
<tr class="md-end-block"><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">字段</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">类型</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">说明</span></span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="md-end-block">

<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">object</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">区域信息</span></span></td>
</tr>

</tr>
</tbody>

<table class="md-table">

&nbsp;  },<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp;  {<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"date": <span class="cm-string">"2026-08-20 00:00:00",<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"week": <span class="cm-string">"星期四",<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"dayWeather": <span class="cm-string">"雷阵雨",<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"nightWeather": <span class="cm-string">"雷阵雨",<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"weather": <span class="cm-string">"雷阵雨",<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"maxTemperature": <span class="cm-number">30,<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string cm-property">"minTemperature": <span class="cm-number">23<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp;  }<br><span> &nbsp;  ]<br><span>  }<br><span>}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<div class="md-hr md-end-block"><hr></div>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">调用示例</span></h2>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">cURL</span></h3>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-comment"># 城市列表<br><span><span class="cm-builtin">curl <span class="cm-attribute">-X GET <span class="cm-string">"https://api.xzt.me/api/weatherArea/list" \<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">-H <span class="cm-string">"Accept: application/json" \<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">-H <span class="cm-string">"Authorization: Bearer &lt;your_token&gt;"<br><span><span>​<br><span><span class="cm-comment"># 实况<br><span><span class="cm-builtin">curl <span class="cm-attribute">-X GET <span class="cm-string">"https://api.xzt.me/api/weatherLive/detail?Id=86101020100" \<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">-H <span class="cm-string">"Accept: application/json" \<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">-H <span class="cm-string">"Authorization: Bearer &lt;your_token&gt;"<br><span><span>​<br><span><span class="cm-comment"># 多日预报<br><span><span class="cm-builtin">curl <span class="cm-attribute">-X GET <span class="cm-string">"https://api.xzt.me/api/weatherForecast/detail?Id=86101020100" \<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">-H <span class="cm-string">"Accept: application/json" \<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">-H <span class="cm-string">"Authorization: Bearer &lt;your_token&gt;"<br><span><span>​<br><span><span class="cm-comment"># 40 天预报<br><span><span class="cm-builtin">curl <span class="cm-attribute">-X GET <span class="cm-string">"https://api.xzt.me/api/weatherForecast40/detail?Id=86101020100" \<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">-H <span class="cm-string">"Accept: application/json" \<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-attribute">-H <span class="cm-string">"Authorization: Bearer &lt;your_token&gt;"</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">JavaScript（fetch）</span></h3>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-keyword">const <span class="cm-def">BASE <span class="cm-operator">= <span class="cm-string">"https://api.xzt.me";<br><span><span class="cm-keyword">const <span class="cm-def">token <span class="cm-operator">= <span class="cm-string">"&lt;your_token&gt;";<br><span><span>​<br><span><span class="cm-keyword">async <span class="cm-keyword">function <span class="cm-def">getLiveWeather(<span class="cm-def">areaId) {<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">const <span class="cm-def">res <span class="cm-operator">= <span class="cm-keyword">await <span class="cm-variable">fetch(<span class="cm-string-2">`${<span class="cm-variable">BASE<span class="cm-string-2">}/api/weatherLive/detail?Id=${<span class="cm-variable-2">areaId<span class="cm-string-2">}`, {<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-property">headers: {<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-property">Accept: <span class="cm-string">"application/json",<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-property">Authorization: <span class="cm-string-2">`Bearer ${<span class="cm-variable">token<span class="cm-string-2">}`,<br><span> &nbsp;  },<br><span>  });<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">const <span class="cm-def">data <span class="cm-operator">= <span class="cm-keyword">await <span class="cm-variable-2">res.<span class="cm-property">json();<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">if (<span class="cm-variable-2">data.<span class="cm-property">code <span class="cm-operator">!== <span class="cm-number">200) <span class="cm-keyword">throw <span class="cm-keyword">new <span class="cm-variable">Error(<span class="cm-variable-2">data.<span class="cm-property">message <span class="cm-operator">|| <span class="cm-string">"请求失败");<br><span> &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">return <span class="cm-variable-2">data.<span class="cm-property">result;<br><span>}<br><span><span>​<br><span><span class="cm-comment">// 示例：北京<br><span><span class="cm-variable">getLiveWeather(<span class="cm-string">"86101020100").<span class="cm-property">then(<span class="cm-variable">console.<span class="cm-property">log);</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">Python（requests）</span></h3>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span><span class="cm-keyword">import <span class="cm-variable">requests<br><span><span>​<br><span><span class="cm-variable">BASE <span class="cm-operator">= <span class="cm-string">"https://api.xzt.me"<br><span><span class="cm-variable">HEADERS <span class="cm-operator">= {<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string">"Accept": <span class="cm-string">"application/json",<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string">"Authorization": <span class="cm-string">"Bearer &lt;your_token&gt;",<br><span>}<br><span><span>​<br><span><span class="cm-keyword">def <span class="cm-def">get_live(<span class="cm-variable">area_id: <span class="cm-builtin">str):<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">r <span class="cm-operator">= <span class="cm-variable">requests.<span class="cm-property">get(<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-string">f"{<span class="cm-variable">BASE}<span class="cm-string">/api/weatherLive/detail",<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">params<span class="cm-operator">={<span class="cm-string">"Id": <span class="cm-variable">area_id},<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">headers<span class="cm-operator">=<span class="cm-variable">HEADERS,<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">timeout<span class="cm-operator">=<span class="cm-number">10,<br><span> &nbsp;  )<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">r.<span class="cm-property">raise_for_status()<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-variable">data <span class="cm-operator">= <span class="cm-variable">r.<span class="cm-property">json()<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">if <span class="cm-variable">data.<span class="cm-property">get(<span class="cm-string">"code") <span class="cm-operator">!= <span class="cm-number">200:<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">raise <span class="cm-variable">RuntimeError(<span class="cm-variable">data.<span class="cm-property">get(<span class="cm-string">"message"))<br><span> &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="cm-keyword">return <span class="cm-variable">data[<span class="cm-string">"result"]<br><span><span>​<br><span><span class="cm-builtin">print(<span class="cm-variable">get_live(<span class="cm-string">"86101020100"))</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
<div class="md-hr md-end-block"><hr></div>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">接入建议</span></h2>
<ol class="ol-list" start="">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>缓存城市列表</strong><span class="md-plain">：<span class="md-pair-s"><code>/api/weatherArea/list</code><span class="md-plain"> 数据相对稳定，建议本地缓存，按省市区检索后再请求实况 / 预报。</span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>按 ID 查询</strong><span class="md-plain">：务必使用列表返回的 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>id</code><span class="md-plain">，不要传无效 ID（会返回 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>[D1002] 记录不存在</code><span class="md-plain">）。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>区分实况与预报</strong><span class="md-plain">：首页展示用 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>weatherLive</code><span class="md-plain">；未来几天用 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>weatherForecast</code><span class="md-plain">；中长期趋势用 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>weatherForecast40</code><span class="md-plain">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>注意字段差异</strong><span class="md-plain">：多日预报拆分白天 / 夜间；40 天预报提供 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>maxTemperature</code><span class="md-plain"> / <span class="md-pair-s"><code>minTemperature</code><span class="md-plain"> 与综合 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>weather</code><span class="md-plain"> 文案。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>错误处理</strong><span class="md-plain">：先判断 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>code</code><span class="md-plain"> / <span class="md-pair-s"><code>type</code><span class="md-plain">，再读取 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>result</code><span class="md-plain">；<span class="md-pair-s"><code>result</code><span class="md-plain"> 可能为 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>null</code><span class="md-plain">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<div class="md-hr md-end-block"><hr></div>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">常见问题 FAQ</span></h2>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>Q：区域 ID 从哪里来？</strong><span class="md-plain"><span class="md-linebreak"> <span class="md-linebreak-mark"> <span class="md-plain">A：调用 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>/api/weatherArea/list</code><span class="md-plain">，匹配 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>province</code><span class="md-plain"> / <span class="md-pair-s"><code>city</code><span class="md-plain"> / <span class="md-pair-s"><code>district</code><span class="md-plain"> 后使用对应 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>id</code><span class="md-plain">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>Q：为什么提示「记录不存在」？</strong><span class="md-plain"><span class="md-linebreak"> <span class="md-linebreak-mark"> <span class="md-plain">A：通常是 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>Id</code><span class="md-plain"> 无效或不在城市列表中。请改用列表中的真实 ID（如北京 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>86101020100</code><span class="md-plain">）。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>Q：实况和预报更新频率？</strong><span class="md-plain"><span class="md-linebreak"> <span class="md-linebreak-mark"> <span class="md-plain">A：实况响应中含 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>updateTime</code><span class="md-plain"> 字段；预报按日维度返回。具体刷新策略以平台侧为准。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>Q：如何在线调试？</strong><span class="md-plain"><span class="md-linebreak"> <span class="md-linebreak-mark"> <span class="md-plain">A：打开 <span class="md-meta-i-c  md-link"><a href="https://api.xzt.me/index.html" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="md-plain">https://api.xzt.me/index.html</span></a><span class="md-plain">，选择「气象数据中台」定义后即可查看与调试接口。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>Q：OpenAPI 定义地址？</strong><span class="md-plain"><span class="md-linebreak"> <span class="md-linebreak-mark"> <span class="md-plain">A：<span class="md-pair-s"><code>https://api.xzt.me/swagger/气象数据/swagger.json</code><span class="md-plain">（也可经 URL 编码访问）。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="md-hr md-end-block">&nbsp;</div>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">&nbsp;</span></h2>
<div class="md-hr md-end-block"><hr></div>
<p class="md-end-block md-p md-focus"><span class="md-pair-s md-expand"><em><span class="md-plain">文档基于公开 OpenAPI（<span class="md-pair-s"><code>气象数据中台</code><span class="md-plain"> v1.0.0）及实测接口响应整理，示例数据以请求时刻为准。</span></span></span></em></span></p>
